text: Agents persist state and can be resumed later from anywhere, across sessions, computers, and interfaces
quote: create an agent once, then resume it from anywhere

text: Self-hosted App Server lets you host agents on a central always-on machine and expose them via the Agent SDK
quote: Run the Letta App Server to host local agents on a central, always-on machine and expose them to client applications through the Agent SDK

text: Background 'dreaming' consolidation can be configured to trigger after N steps, on context compaction, or never
quote: trigger controls when dreaming runs: after a number of steps, on context compaction, or never.

text: Headless mode runs the CLI non-interactively for scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and UNIX tool composition
quote: Headless mode allows you to run Letta Code non-interactively, making it easy to integrate into scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or compose with other UNIX tools.

text: You can fork the current conversation, including its in-context history, to branch without altering the original thread
quote: Use /fork to branch the current conversation, including its in-context history. The new conversation can take a different direction without changing the original thread

text: Users can explicitly teach the agent new facts/rules with a /remember command
quote: You can also teach it explicitly with /remember: > /remember always use pnpm in this repo

text: Multiple agents can share a common memory repository so they access the same files and working context
quote: Shared memory gives multiple agents access to the same files and working context. Each shared memory repository is a Git repository hosted in Letta Cloud

text: You can create a named shared-memory workspace via CLI (letta shared-memory create)
quote: letta shared-memory create --name team-memory

text: Signing in backs up agents to the cloud, making them accessible via chat.letta.com, desktop app, remote machines, and messaging integrations
quote: Run /login to back up your agents to the cloud and make them available through chat.letta.com, the desktop app, remote machines, and messaging integrations.

text: A /doctor command audits the memory hierarchy for placement, duplication, and system-prompt token usage
quote: If the memory hierarchy has drifted or grown too large, run /doctor to audit placement, duplication, and system-prompt token usage.

text: You can fully specify an agent's starting memory as Markdown files stored in its memory repository
quote: Pass memory for full control over the agent’s starting memory. Each entry becomes a Markdown file in the agent’s memory repository

text: An --ephemeral flag runs a one-shot task without creating or persisting any agent, memory blocks, or MemFS
quote: Use --ephemeral to run a one-shot task without creating, resuming, or persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS

text: Desktop app and CLI can reuse your own API keys/coding plans, while the web app runs agents in a managed cloud sandbox with no local setup
quote: The desktop app and CLI can use your existing API keys and coding plans, while the web app runs agents in a cloud sandbox with no local setup

text: CLI supports browsing/switching between agents (/agents) and pinning favorites
quote: Use /agents in the CLI to browse and switch agents. Pin an agent with /pin or the favorite control in the desktop app

text: A /btw command lets you ask a side question that forks the conversation in the background without interrupting the main task
quote: Use /btw for a side question. It forks the conversation in the background and returns the answer without interrupting your main task

text: You can connect your own laptop, workstation, or cloud VM so the agent gets access to its files and tools
quote: To give your agent access to files and tools on your laptop, workstation, or cloud VM, connect your own machine and select it from the environment picker

text: The App Server exposes an OpenAI-compatible API usable by clients like Open WebUI, plus an ACP adapter for clients like Zed
quote: use the App Server’s OpenAI-compatible API with clients such as Open WebUI, or the ACP adapter with ACP clients such as Zed

text: Background subagents ('dreaming') review recent conversations, consolidate lessons, and update memory automatically without interrupting active work
quote: Dreaming uses background subagents to review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons, and update memory without interrupting your active work.

text: An optional MemFS Search mod adds keyword, semantic, or hybrid search over memory
quote: For keyword search and optional semantic or hybrid search, install the [MemFS Search mod]

text: Letta agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control
quote: Letta agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control

text: Default local mode stores agent state on your own machine and requires no Letta login
quote: This default local mode stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login.

text: The App Server can be deployed to run the Letta agent harness as a service
quote: The Letta App Server lets you deploy the Letta agent harness as a service.

text: The web app defaults to a managed cloud sandbox so agents run without configuring a computer
quote: The web app uses a managed cloud sandbox by default, so you can start without configuring a computer.

text: You can sync a GitHub org to Letta via the Integrations page
quote: Sync your GitHub org to Letta on the [Integrations] page.

text: A dedicated Agent SDK lets developers build agents into TypeScript applications
quote: the Letta Agent SDK for building agents into TypeScript applications

text: Brand-new accounts start with an onboarding agent called Tutor
quote: Brand-new accounts start in Tutor, an onboarding agent.

text: Pro plan users can run agents in remote sandboxes, get usage quota for Letta Auto, and purchase additional model credits
quote: With the Pro plan, you can run agents in remote sandboxes, access usage quota for Letta Auto, and purchase credits to use across models

text: Free/base plan supports up to 20 stateful agents
quote: Up to 20 stateful agents

text: Visiting chat.letta.com and signing in gives browser/phone access to your agents
quote: Visit chat.letta.com from your browser or phone and sign in with your Letta account.
